messages:
Maya (Design): Pushed a new compact starter-strip variant to figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzzzz/starter-strip-compact. Main idea: horizontal pill of 3 sample projects + a subtle progress seed for "first-run" tasks.
Evan (PM): Nice. We need to prioritize which projects show first. Can we order by lowest infra cost + fastest cold-start?
Maya (Design): Yes — propose ordering: 'Text summarizer (small)', 'Intent classifier (tiny)', 'Embeddings demo (quantized)'. Others behind a "more samples" overflow.
Sam (Frontend): Implementation notes: we'll lazy-render thumbnails to avoid blocking main bundle. But the pill needs to be keyboard-navigable and swipable on mobile. CSS-wise I can do `display:flex; gap:12px; overflow:auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;`
Riley (A11y): A few nits: 1) Ensure each sample has `role="button"` and `aria-pressed` for active selection; 2) The progress seed (visual only) requires an `aria-hidden=true` and a visible text alternative like "1 of 3 starter tasks"; 3) Color contrast for the pill background fails AA on some cards — need darker bg or darker text.
Maya (Design): Good call. I'll darken the pill surface to #111827 at 92% and use 16px semibold for card titles. Also adding an SR-only counter span for the progress.
Evan (PM): Copy tweak: replace "Get started" with "Run in your workspace" to make the action explicit. Also change tooltip for overflow to "See more starter projects".
Sam (Frontend): Quick prototype pushed to the dev branch. ci-bot created preview: https://preview.internal/changes/9921. Mobile swipe worked but the focus order got weird when overflow menu opens.
Riley (A11y): When overflow opens, trap focus inside that menu and ensure escape closes it. Don't auto-focus the first item unless the user used keyboard to open. Also verify screen reader announcement: "Opened starter projects list" via polite live region.
Maya (Design): I'll add a tiny keyboard hint pill: "Press / to open quickstart" next to the strip, visually subdued. Make sure it isn't announced immediately.
Sam (Frontend): Agree — implemented the hint as a `<button aria-hidden="false">` with visually-hidden description for SRs. Fixed focus trap bug in the preview.
ci-bot: Preview passed E2E smoke and Lighthouse check: https://ci.internal/report/9921 :white_check_mark:
Evan (PM): Great. Next steps: finalize contrast numbers and ship to beta for a small cohort. Maya, can you update the jobs ticket with the final assets and copy?
Maya (Design): On it — I'll attach final specs and the a11y checklist. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
